column2: Hello, little Spirit Mage. My name is Shannon. I am journeying all across Celtland.⏎▼⏎It seems you are about to set out on a journey of your own. Perhaps we will meet again somewhere.
I've heard talk of you on my travels. You are no ordinary Spirit Mage, it seems.

You're the Spirit Mage I saw in Impaness, aren't you? I'm amazed you reached Darlam so quickly!⏎▼⏎But you won't get any farther than this. They say a bandit has appeared in the forest near this town and closed off the road through to Lake Lenos.⏎▼⏎How troublesome. I wanted to go to Lake Lenos too...
How surprising. That is the Earth Orb. Legend has it that only the true Spiritcaller can draw out its power.
Across this lake lies Lalapool, City of Water. In Angulus, the merchant nation, it is a town as beautiful as the castle town of Rideen.

We meet again, little Spirit Mage. Did you come to this town too, because the ferry isn't running?⏎▼⏎I can't quite tell what the cause is... but perhaps some ill force is at work on the spirits.⏎▼⏎Beyond Windward Forest to the south lies Haliel, the Wind Town. And this is Lalapool, City of Water.⏎▼⏎You may find some clue in those two towns.
I have heard that whoever gathers all four Spirit Gems can gain tremendous power.⏎▼⏎But they say that unless one is the true Spiritcaller, that power cannot be drawn out.

So you've come as far as Haliel too. Windward Forest lies just beside this town, and I have a bad feeling about it.⏎▼⏎The Wind Spirit is restless as well. When you go into the forest, you would do well to be very careful.
Have you noticed, little Spirit Mage? The stirring of the spirits has quieted a little.⏎▼⏎But somewhere else, it seems, a far greater power is on the move.

What a splendid town Rideen is. So beautiful, so grand...⏎▼⏎Strange, though, isn't it? A human life is such a fleeting thing. So why build a town that could be lived in for a thousand years?⏎▼⏎...I cannot understand it.

Spirit Mage, have you seen the state of this town? This is the work of King Geas of Blanick.⏎▼⏎He gained great power, and merely to try it out, he burned the town to the ground and made its people suffer.⏎▼⏎Why do people destroy the very things they took such pains to build?⏎...I cannot understand it.
So at last you have gathered all four Spirit Gems. Now, if you are the true Spiritcaller, you should be able to draw out their power.⏎▼⏎Your father, it seems, has already set out for Blanick Castle.
Oh, Jean-Jacques. Little Spirit Mage. Your father... in the battle with King Geas, he...⏎▼⏎No one but you can stop that man now. Do something, Jean-Jacques, please!!

Jean-Jacques. You have been chosen... by the One......⏎▼⏎Just as I thought, you have grown strong. Solvaring, Zelse, Nepty, Fargo... and Geas. I was lending my power to them all.⏎▼⏎So that, by defeating them, you would grow strong enough to wield the Spirit Gems.⏎▼⏎You have gained power enough to open the way to the place where the One awaits!⏎▼⏎Now, here is the Book of Ether. Take it and go on to the Stone Circle ahead. There you will learn what the truth of your journey is.
Go on now, Jean-Jacques. Go and learn the truth...... That is your destiny.

Jean-Jacques. It has been a long journey, hasn't it? I have lived only to lead you here...⏎▼⏎...And my part, too, ends here.⏎▼⏎Strange, isn't it? The One and I were both born of you humans. Yes -- of the ugliness in human hearts.⏎▼⏎And yet you humans tried to make use even of beings like us. Again, out of ugly hearts.⏎▼⏎But by drinking in that ugliness, the One grew mighty... into a being with no heart but the will to destroy.⏎▼⏎That is why we needed Ether. We needed a reason to live, the way you humans live.⏎▼⏎Come now. The One is waiting.⏎▼⏎If you are truly one chosen by the spirits, the true Spiritcaller, then the monsters will vanish from this world, and peace will come once more.

What am I doing here? Keeping an eye out in case monsters come in from the sea. Lord Bart, the town's protector, is away, you see.⏎▼⏎Now there's a splendid Spiritcaller. Hope you grow up to be just like him soon, Jean-Jacques.

Impaness is a town blessed by the spirits, so I reckon there's a spirit or two hiding around here somewhere.⏎▼⏎But hunting for 'em is way too much bother. Not something the likes of me could ever manage.

I'm a traveler, journeying all across Celtland.⏎▼⏎I hail from Rideen, as it happens. Impaness lies at the far north of Celtland, so getting all the way here was hard going.⏎▼⏎Impaness is a fine town too, but Rideen has the finest castle in all the land.

Lately I hear monsters have been multiplying along the highway, and that a bandit has turned up in the forest. Whatever can it mean? What a frightening thing.⏎▼⏎Ever since Lord Bart set off on his journey, it's been nothing but news like this.

Your father, Lord Bart, is adored by everyone in town. Why, I've never seen a finer man.⏎▼⏎The people of the Sanctum seldom come down into town, but Lord Bart makes his rounds and is kind enough to look out for everyone's safety.
Hey! When I grow up, do you think I could be a Spiritcaller like you?
I'm a pirate, I am! All the treasure in the world is mine! And I ain't scared of no monsters!
Guess what! There's a great big scaaary rabbit hopping around outside town!
Jean-Jacques, I'll tell you something good!⏎▼⏎While you hold down the B Button, the camera moves behind you, so it's easier to see!
Hey, hey! Did your daddy say you could play outside?⏎▼⏎My mommy said outside is full of monsters, so it's dangerous. Aren't you scaaared?

This is a tale from long, long ago, mind you. They say that on account of a certain book, Celtland was struck by a terrible calamity.⏎▼⏎Green lands turned to desert in a single night, and the towns that flourished there simply vanished, or so it's said.⏎▼⏎Which is to say, man must never use what lies beyond the understanding of man.
Baaa~
Baaaa~
Was my grandchild out playing happily, eh?⏎▼⏎That we can live here in peace like this is all thanks to the Sanctum's warding magic. We're grateful for it, truly we are.
Tired, are you, little Spirit Mage? Why not have a rest at our place? I'll write your travels in the register for you, too.⏎▼⏎Will you be staying?{F2}

Setting off on a journey, are you? Then I'll give you some Traveler's White Wings.⏎▼⏎Use them, and you can come back to Impaness any time.⏎▼⏎There's just one condition on using the Wings, though.⏎▼⏎The Wings only work in open places, like plains and towns, you see.
Oh, looks like you've still got your Traveler's White Wings. I'll give you some another time.
Billy and Frank both keep on playing even after the sun goes down. I wish they'd follow your example, young Spirit Mage.

A traveler? Now there's a rare sight, with every road so dangerous of late, eh? .........Oh?⏎▼⏎You seem to carry a rare fate, one such as I have never seen. One an ordinary soul would hardly know what to do with...⏎▼⏎The likes of me cannot see it clearly, mind, but it seems the journey ahead of you is what will carve out that fate.

Oh my, is that not a Spirit Gem? The Gems coming together may lead to ill, or it may lead to good. Take heed as you go.⏎▼⏎Let me give you one piece of advice. To move the water, first you must move the wind. That will open a new path, I should think.
Down this road lie the town of Darlam and Jeanbat Forest. But I hear tell there's a bandit in that forest.⏎▼⏎A youngster like you had best not wander in there careless-like, eh?
I heard all about it! A youngster like you, putting an end to that bandit! You'll make a splendid Spiritcaller one of these days, mark my words!

The spirits are hiding all over the place. Try walking into every nook and corner of towns, the outdoors and caves!⏎▼⏎And when you win battles, the spirits lend you their power.⏎▼⏎You're strong, Jean-Jacques, so you'll be just fine!

When you want to open a treasure chest, go right up close to it. When the '!' mark appears, press the Z Button.⏎▼⏎Inside you'll find items that come in handy on your journey. There are a few here in the Sanctum too, so go have a look!

Jean-Jacques, if you're heading out on a journey, let me teach you how to fight.⏎▼⏎When you meet monsters, a large circle forms around you. That is the battle circle.⏎▼⏎Inside the battle circle, a second, smaller circle forms as well. That one is for moving, and it's called the movement circle.⏎▼⏎You can move freely inside the movement circle, but once you use magic, strike an enemy with your staff, or use an item, you can no longer move.⏎▼⏎Of course, you can also move outside the battle circle. Decide on an action while you're outside it, and you'll escape from the battle.⏎▼⏎If things get dangerous, running away is sometimes necessary too.
Take care out there, Jean-Jacques. Here, these are Mint Leaves. Can't go on a long journey without 'em. Take them with you!
When you run out of Mint Leaves, come see me again. I'll give you more any time.

O spirits, protect this one who is still so young. Grant a guiding light upon the path he walks...⏎▼⏎All we can do is pray, but until the day you return, we shall go on praying for your safety.⏎▼⏎In his last letter, Bart wrote that he would cross Lake Lenos and go on to Lalapool.⏎▼⏎I understand how worried you are about Bart, but don't do anything too reckless.

Leave the Sanctum, and from the town of Impaness make your way to the town of Darlam.⏎▼⏎I shall ask the King of Darlam to lend you his strength.⏎▼⏎Hear me: any deed that makes light of your own life, I shall never permit. Return safe to the Sanctum.

In Celtland there are four Spirit Gems. They are said to be needed to quell the calamity unleashed by the Book of Ether.⏎▼⏎Yet until now, only one has ever held all four: a single great Spiritcaller, a thousand years ago.⏎▼⏎That one of them has now come into your hands is a matter of great importance. Never let it go.
So you're setting off on your journey, Jean-Jacques. Everyone at the Sanctum has been worried, so you'd better go have a word with them.

Jean-Jacques, did you know? Spirits hide in all sorts of places. When you get close, a '?' mark appears, so press the Z Button there.⏎▼⏎Four spirit marks will appear. Press whichever one of the C Buttons matches the spirit you want.⏎▼⏎When you do, that spirit lends you its power in its element.⏎▼⏎Of the four C Buttons, the Fire Spirit is C-Up, Water is C-Down, Earth is C-Left and Wind is C-Right!
Neighhh!

Hey, you heard? A bandit's gone and made himself at home in Jeanbat Forest. And on top of that, they say he stole some precious treasure right out of the castle!⏎▼⏎Of all the outrageous... If even the castle soldiers couldn't handle him, he must be one HUGE brute!
They say the bandit's gone, but who in the world got rid of him? Even the soldiers couldn't beat him, and they ganged up on him all at once.⏎▼⏎He must be one tremendously HUGE fellow.
Damn it! That stinkin' bandit! Him tearin' up the forest means I can't get a lick of work done!⏎▼⏎The castle soldiers ain't worth a thing, neither. Right, then -- I'll go sort him out myself!
Damn it! That stinkin' bandit! Went and got himself beat before I could get there. Wasn't much to him after all, was there?
*hic* Me, I'm... a clay digger... see... *hic* But right now... *hic* I got the day off!⏎▼⏎*hic* Every now 'n' then... a fella needs... a day off... *hic* Ain't that right, lad... *hic*
*hic* They say the bandit's been beat... So now I can... *hic* go back to work... without a worry... *hic* that's how it is.⏎▼⏎*hic* Dunno who it was... but here's to whoever done it! Cheers!
I'm a potter, but with that bandit around I can't get my hands on any good clay. At this rate I won't be making any good pots.
The hard part of pottery is the fire -- getting it just right is tricky. It's only when the Fire Spirit and the Earth Spirit join their strength that you get a really good piece.

Do you know about Princess Flora? She's ever so lovely, but she's brave, too.⏎▼⏎In this bandit business, I hear she was the very first to try to go and deal with him herself, and the King was in an absolute panic!

My old man's a clay digger, y'know. Digs up some pretty decent clay, too, but then that bandit turned up, didn't he?⏎▼⏎So now he won't do a lick of work. Well, if that's how it's gonna be, he could at least help me clean the house, couldn't he!
So they've finally gone and got rid of that bandit, eh? Took 'em long enough, didn't it?
Oh my, what a cuuute Spirit Mage! Let me treat you to some juice, sweetie. Here you go -- Morning Dew!
Aww, and I was going to treat you to some Morning Dew, but you've already got some. Next time, then, sweetie!
They say even the King is having trouble with that bandit in the forest. Who knows when he might come and attack the town? I'm so worried I can't even let my daughter play outside...
The bandit seems to be gone. I'm so glad! Now I can let my daughter go out and play again. Children really ought to play outdoors, after all.
Daddy and Mommy say I'm not allowed to go play outside. 'Cause a bandit came and it's dangerous.⏎▼⏎But what's a bandit?
Guess what, guess what! The bandit's gone! They said I can go play outside now. Yaaay!⏎▼⏎But what's a bandit?

Have you heard about the bandit of Jeanbat? They say he sneaked into the castle, struck down the soldiers and made off with the treasure.⏎▼⏎That treasure, so I'm told, is called the Earth Orb. It's said that it calmed the calamity that once fell upon Celtland, you know.
I hear that bandit in the forest has been dealt with, eh? Now then, young one, would you happen to know what became of the castle's treasure?

You'd be a Spirit Mage from Melrode, then. A long journey all on your own must be hard going. Here, I'll give you these Traveler's Yellow Wings.⏎▼⏎Oh, and one more thing, don't forget: the Wings can't be used in caves or forests.
Huh, looks like you've already got Traveler's Yellow Wings. Well then, come back when you run out.
Welcome to Darlam, the Earth Town! If you like, why not stay the night?{F2}
I came across Lake Lenos to buy pottery in this town, see.⏎▼⏎But then a bandit showed up in the forest, and now I can't get back to Lake Lenos. What a mess, honestly...
The forest's open again! So I can head home whenever I like now -- so I think I'll take it easy here a little longer.
Welcome to the Darlam tavern! I'll bet you're hungry, aren't you, lad?⏎▼⏎Here, take some Honey Bread. On the road, food's the most important thing there is.
I'll give you Honey Bread any time you like, dear. Come back when you run out.
Welcome to Darlam Castle. You must be the Spirit Mage from Melrode.⏎▼⏎King Glen Scottfort awaits you in the throne room.

Welcome, Spirit Mage. I have heard the tale from the Spirit Hierarch's envoy. You set out after Sir Bart, who went in search of the Book of Ether, or so I am told.⏎▼⏎The loss of the Book of Ether is a grave matter for this kingdom as well. That tome must never be loosed upon the world.⏎▼⏎But even now, a dire trouble has befallen this castle. A bandit stole the castle's treasure, the Earth Orb, and to crown it all he has closed off the road to Lake Lenos as he pleases.⏎▼⏎I sent soldiers into the forest, but they were no match for him at all. He wields some uncanny magic, and it has us hard-pressed.⏎▼⏎By rights I would lend you soldiers, but I have already lost a great many. One way or another, that bandit must be dealt with.

That a child such as you could defeat that bandit... You astonish me. Just as the Spirit Hierarch said, you are no ordinary child.⏎▼⏎I entrust the Earth Orb to you. It is a treasure only a Spiritcaller can wield. It may prove of use in your search for Sir Bart.⏎▼⏎As a small token of my thanks, I have opened the hidden door behind the throne. Take whatever you wish from the treasury beyond.
Welcome, Spirit Mage. We were informed of your coming by the Spirit Hierarch's envoy.

A bandit got into this castle the other day. We took him lightly, him being just one man, and then he came at us with some incredible magic.⏎▼⏎Everyone who got close to him was taken down. Maybe we should've kept our distance and chipped away at him bit by bit...⏎▼⏎A kid like you would get sent flying with one punch from him. Well, not that you'd ever think of doing anything that reckless.
You're the one who beat the bandit? Really? Spiritcallers sure have some amazing power.
Beyond here lies the throne room. You would be the Spirit Mage the Sanctum sent word of. Please, proceed.
A bandit slipped in just recently, so we've taken to checking everyone who visits the castle very strictly.⏎▼⏎Still, I'd think someone from the Sanctum is all right.
That's... the Earth Orb...! Surely you don't mean you defeated that bandit! I can scarcely believe it!
We have heard of your circumstances from the Spirit Hierarch. However, at present the castle faces a grave crisis.⏎▼⏎Whatever it takes, we must recover the stolen Earth Orb.

So it was you who defeated the bandit for us! Until now, I had believed there was no power greater than a knight's sword.⏎▼⏎I never imagined the power of magic could be so great. I see it in a new light now.
Oh my, Spirit Mage! This is Princess Flora's chamber. If His Majesty finds you here, there'll be a dreadful to-do!

Barging in without so much as a greeting -- isn't that ruder than the bandit himself? Still, I like you. You're a Spiritcaller, aren't you?⏎▼⏎Has anyone told you about the bandit? He's settled into an old fort no one uses anymore, and he's running riot as if he owned the place.⏎▼⏎If you have the courage, won't you go to the forest and find out what the bandit is up to? If you can use magic, I'd feel so much better.⏎▼⏎The townspeople and the castle soldiers have all lost their nerve... Please, I'm asking you -- lend us your strength.

Thank you for protecting the town of Darlam, and everyone in it. You're only a child, yet you have such wonderful power!⏎▼⏎I can't believe you're just an ordinary Spiritcaller. I can't quite put it into words, but I can feel it.
Welcome to the lakeside inn. Will you be staying with us?{F2}
I'm awfully fond of Lake Lenos, you see. I stay at this inn quite often.⏎▼⏎I've never seen it myself, but they say there's an island right in the middle of Lake Lenos. Have you ever seen it?
I wouldn't take anything old Griyon down the street says too seriously. You can never tell if it's true or not.
Don't recognize your face. Traveling through, are you? I can't imagine heading off on a dangerous journey like that. Stay in town, and the monsters won't come after you.

I did my share of traveling too, when I was young.⏎▼⏎Heard all sorts of stories out on the road, but the most frightening of the lot, no question about it, was the tale of the Day of Calamity.⏎▼⏎Long ago, the nations fought over a book that held tremendous magical power. The fighting went on for decades, but at last one nation came out on top.⏎▼⏎That nation used the power of the book it had finally won. But the very next moment, the heavens split, light from the sky covered the land, and the nation was destroyed in a single day, so they say.⏎▼⏎That day is called the Day of Calamity. But they say a great Spiritcaller quelled that power.

Ever heard the name Crystal Valley? They say it's a place lovely as a dream, where a great many spirits live and breathe.⏎▼⏎I'd like to see a valley that beautiful just once... But nobody knows where it is.
There's a Spiritcaller in this town, Lady Leila. Thanks to her warding magic, we can live here safe and sound like this.
Lalapool, you know, is called the City of Water. Rideen's splendid too, but Lalapool's the best!
I'm having my Prim take singing lessons. I want to make her the best singer in all Celtland.

'...When the guarding waters recede... la la la... the path to the Crystal Valley... lu lu lu... shall... la la la... be opened...'⏎▼⏎I'm practicing my song right now. You know what? When I grow up, I want to sing at the castle in Rideen, in front of the prince.

This town, y'see, was made long, long ago by one Spiritcaller.⏎▼⏎When that Spiritcaller dug a well hereabouts, the water came gushing up fit to overflow, and so Lalapool, the town of water, came to be.⏎▼⏎Now, that well the Spiritcaller dug, they call it the Crystal Well, and whoever lays eyes on it gets a curse put on 'em.⏎▼⏎Eh? Or was it something else, now...

My name is Leila. I am the one who protects this town. I have been awaiting you.⏎▼⏎Are you aware that the wind has ceased in this land? The cause lies near Haliel, the Wind Town.⏎▼⏎This world is made of the four spirits. Should any one of them grow too strong, or wane, the balance is broken.⏎▼⏎And once the balance is broken, there is no telling what may come to pass. I beg you, Spirit Mage, lend us your strength.

Spirit Mage, the wind has returned. Thank you so very much. You are truly the one Lady Epona spoke of...⏎▼⏎Besides protecting this town, I also serve as the messenger who carries the words of Lady Epona of Crystal Valley.⏎▼⏎Lady Epona is a mysterious lady. She has the power to see through all things; there is nothing she does not know.⏎▼⏎Lady Epona awaits you in the valley. She says there is something she wishes to tell you.⏎▼⏎Outside the inn is the room of the Crystal Well. When you are ready, please come to the well. I will lead you to Lady Epona.

I have been expecting you. Let us draw back the guarding waters and open the way to the sacred Crystal Valley. Once the waters recede, the mouth of a cave will appear.⏎▼⏎The cave is very long, and there are many monsters, but you must pass through it, so that it may be proven whether you are the true Spiritcaller.⏎▼⏎Lady Epona awaits you in the valley. Now, please hurry. The waters stay drawn back for only a short while.⏎▼⏎May the blessing of the spirits be upon your journey...
Aiding you on your journey is our duty.⏎▼⏎Though beside the greatness of the destiny you bear, our help is a humble thing indeed...
I ran away from Grinos. On my own... leaving everyone behind.⏎▼⏎What's happening in that town now, I wonder? Oh, Mother...
You're crossing Lake Lenos? A kid like you, traveling with that kind of courage...⏎▼⏎Then I can't just not go back, can I? I'll go back someday, I swear it. Back to my mother, no matter what...
Ah, young man, a traveler, I see. Then you'll be needing Traveler's Blue Wings. Go on, take them with you.⏎▼⏎Oh--⏎▼⏎The Wings can't be used in caves or forests, mind. Don't forget it.
Aw, come on, young man. And here I was, all set to give you some Traveler's Blue Wings. You've already got 'em.
Hey there, lad. This here's an inn that doubles as a tavern. Stay the night, if you've a mind to.{F2}
Hee hee, you're on a dangerous journey, aren't you, little one? Here, have some nice cool Mint Leaves.
Hee hee, so you've already got Mint Leaves, little one. When they run out, you come here. I'll pick some just for you.

That lot outside look to be searching for something or other, but I wish they'd hurry up and clear off out of here.⏎▼⏎And anyway, I can't make head or tail of what goes on in young folks' heads these days. That Spiritcaller who came to town the other day.........⏎▼⏎Zelse, I think he said his name was. A Spiritcaller, and he didn't so much as say hello to us. His sort, the spirits won't take a liking to.⏎▼⏎A Spiritcaller, first and foremost, has got to be liked by the spirits.⏎▼⏎To be liked by the spirits, you do good deeds and treat nature with care. Even those monsters that come at you were spirits to begin with.⏎▼⏎Set free the spirits living in the monsters and they'll be on your side. And for that, you've got to build up your strength and train properly.⏎▼⏎......⏎▼⏎By the way, what's your best magic? Me, in the old days they called me Mais the Watercaller.⏎▼⏎My name thundered across all Celtland. Well? Impressive, eh?

That lot outside still haven't gone home. Honestly, if they don't clear off soon, I'll never get any peace.⏎▼⏎But you, little as you are, seem to be well liked by the spirits. Good. That's the most important thing for a Spiritcaller.⏎▼⏎I was the same, in my day. After all, the name of Mais the Watercaller rang out across all Celtland.⏎▼⏎Mind you, back when we were still active, it was peaceful, not like now.⏎▼⏎It's you young ones who've got to make the world peaceful from here on. So give it your all.⏎▼⏎......⏎▼⏎By the way, what's your best magic? Mine's Healing. I'll teach you sometime, if you like.
Oh ho, well, well. A rare guest indeed. A Spiritcaller... my, that takes me back.⏎▼⏎I was a Spirit Mage myself, once upon a time. I wonder, is the Spirit Hierarch still keeping well?

Oh ho, well, well. You've grown a size bigger again, haven't you?⏎▼⏎By the way, I feel I've seen that face somewhere before. Could you be Bart's son?⏎▼⏎Now that I think of it, Bart came by here about two weeks ago. Seemed to be looking for something, he did.

You're a Spirit Mage from Melrode, are you? Little as you are, you've done well to come all this way.⏎▼⏎The old folk living here were all Spirit Mages once, you know. Now we live quietly, without using magic.⏎▼⏎By the way, you'd best not get to talking with the old fellow next door. He'll go on and on, he will.

The stirring of the spirits seems to have died away. Was it you who calmed them? You must have a good deal of power after all.⏎▼⏎By the way, you'd best not get to talking with the old fellow next door. He'll go on and on, he will.
A journey of training, is it? Now that's admirable. Here, let me give you some Honey Bread. Come back any time you run out.
A journey of training, is it? Now that's admirable. Come back any time your Honey Bread runs out. I'll have some fresh from the oven for you.
Hey, you. Seen a silver-haired man with a sharp look in his eye around here?⏎▼⏎Truth is, I couldn't care less about the man himself. It's that jewel of his I've got business with.
Damn that Zelse. Where the devil did he vanish to? Ain't he around these parts no more?⏎▼⏎Can't be helped. Guess I'll head on to Rideen or someplace. Can't hang around this town forever.
You know a Spiritcaller called Zelse? Guy uses some scary magic.⏎▼⏎Word is, if you take that jewel he's carrying to Blanick, they'll pay you a fortune for it.
Nothing but trouble since I came to this town. I don't care about the money anymore. I just wanna go home.
That rat... Where the heck'd he get off to?⏎▼⏎Hey, boy, you seen a silver-haired Spiritcaller? You spot him, you tell me.
Where'd that Zelse get off to? We've looked high and low and still can't find him. Don't tell me he's run off somewhere far away already.

That getup -- you're a Spiritcaller, right? I'm a Spiritcaller too. I'm still in training, but I'm stronger than you!⏎▼⏎But Bart, the Spiritcaller from Melrode, is ten times stronger than me. I wanna get that strong too, and fast.⏎▼⏎Then I'd never lose to some Spiritcaller out in the forest.⏎▼⏎Oops!⏎▼⏎The part about me losing is a secret, okay?
Wow! You got the Wind Jade! You're a lot more powerful than you look.⏎▼⏎Not that I'm jealous or anything. So there.

Have you seen my younger brother? His name is Zelse. He is a Spiritcaller, the same as you. We came here from Grinos, the two of us.⏎▼⏎At long last we reached this town, and yet before long my brother left it.⏎▼⏎His parting words were that someone had given him a jewel, and that he had gained power.........⏎▼⏎What could that jewel he carried mean? Oh, Zelse, where in the world are you.........

You have met Zelse, haven't you? You needn't say anything. It could not be helped.⏎▼⏎My brother and I lived in the town of Grinos. One day, the soldiers of Blanick came pouring into the town, and the whole town became a sea of fire.........⏎▼⏎My brother hated King Geas of Blanick. That is why, he said, he would gain power and take his revenge. That jewel changed him.⏎▼⏎People change once they gain power, don't they? He was such a gentle boy, truly.........
Well now, what a sweet little Spirit Mage. Let's see, suppose this old granny gives you some Traveler's Green Wings, hm?
Once you've used up the Traveler's Green Wings, I'll give you more, so don't you worry. Now mind how you go on your travels.
Sonny, looks like you're on a rough journey, aren't you? It's nothing fancy, but there's a warm bed here. Why don't you stay the night at this inn?{F2}
Rideen is the biggest, grandest town in all Celtland. And the finest house in it is this one -- mine! Why, it's got two whole treasure chests!
Hello there, traveler. This is Rideen, the most prosperous town in Celtland.

My daughter is the very same age as Prince Billiam. Ours is a noble family of proper lineage, so I'd say she's a perfect match for the prince.⏎▼⏎If only he'd take a fancy to her, my daughter would be the prince's bride. And then I'd be royalty too... *dreamy sigh*

Mother wants to make me the prince's bride, it seems. But I can't stand weedy-looking boys like him.⏎▼⏎I want someone brave and strong, with a name known all over Celtland.⏎▼⏎I know about you. You're really strong, aren't you? Do you have a girlfriend?
If you leave Rideen and keep climbing up the mountain a good long way, there's an abandoned mine. They say there's some old ruins way down at the back of it.
I hear there was somebody shady down in the ruins. No wonder the mine got abandoned. Can't do any work when it's that dangerous, right?

Oh, do come in. Would you be a Spirit Mage, by any chance?⏎▼⏎Someone from the Sanctum came by once before. He seemed to be on a journey, searching for something, but a few days ago he left this house.⏎▼⏎Oh, I can't forget the warmth of that man... If you meet him, I want you to give him a message: 'I'll be waiting.'

Have you heard the talk about Fargo? The man who tried to take over Rideen. He can use the most fearsome fire magic.⏎▼⏎Did you see the ruined house on the edge of town? It was a great noble's home, but Fargo's magic burned it down.⏎▼⏎He was shut up in the jail, but he broke out the other day. Where he is now, who knows... I just hope he doesn't come back to this town.
Fargo's at Boiled Hole, across the desert? Why, Boiled Hole is right near Blanick, isn't it!⏎▼⏎What in the world would he go to a place like that for?

Have you seen my boys? Fargo the murderer has escaped, you know. It would be dreadful if anything happened.⏎▼⏎Please -- I'm sorry to trouble you, but if you see my boys, could you tell them to come home?
Hey, you know what? There was a murderer in the jail at the edge of town! He burned everybody to a crisp with fire magic!
Come play with us! We're practicing how to beat Fargo!
Our nation, Angulus, was founded by a great merchant by the name of Hawthorn Shriker.⏎▼⏎Queen Diana, who rules us now, was his wife.
Hey, hey, Fargo got out, they said! He's a scary murderer, they said! He's really amazing, they said!⏎▼⏎...But what's a murderer?
Mom says I gotta go home? Mom's always nagging. I don't wanna go home yet.

Traveling, and you so small? Looks like you've come from Impaness, but the road on from here is a hard one.⏎▼⏎Get through the mine south of Rideen and there's a desert. Go on further still...⏎▼⏎and you come to Veragoon, land of the sword and fire. Come to think of it, that Fargo who broke out of jail the other day was from Veragoon too.

Oh my, a little traveler. I saw someone dressed much like you once before.⏎▼⏎That person seemed to be heading for the mine... Are you planning to go to the mine too?⏎▼⏎You'd best not, not now. Fargo the murderer may be prowling about. Don't you go doing anything reckless.
I'm a traveling merchant, you see. I've got loads of Smelling Salts going spare, so I'll give you some.
I'm a traveling merchant, you see. If you run out of Smelling Salts, just say the word. I've got some going spare.
Tired, are you? I'd think so. It's dangerous out there, and the road's hard. Rest up here, if you like.{F2}
I heard a traveler say there's a phantom town out in the desert... Wonder if it's true.
A long journey's tough going for a kid. Here, have this: Traveler's Red Wings. With them, you can come back to Rideen any time.
Oh, you've already got Traveler's Red Wings. Well then, I'll give you more once they're gone.
Ohohoho... My house is the most splendid house in all of Rideen, you know. You ask why?⏎▼⏎Why, because it has TWO treasure chests! Ohohoho...

Welcome, Spirit Mage. I have had a letter from Princess Flora of Darlam.⏎▼⏎To think that the Book of Ether should be stolen... A terrible thing has happened indeed.⏎▼⏎Here in our town as well, a most fearsome Fire Spiritcaller by the name of Fargo has escaped, and we are at our wits' end.⏎▼⏎What is more, King Geas of Blanick has been making most unsettling moves.⏎▼⏎I do hope nothing ill comes of it.
I thank you for defeating Fargo.⏎▼⏎I see. So Fargo was making for Blanick.⏎▼⏎But what can be happening in Blanick now, I wonder?

So you're the Spirit Mage Mother was talking about? You're about the same age as me, and you're traveling all by yourself. Wow, that's amazing!⏎▼⏎Mother wants great warriors who can protect the kingdom.⏎▼⏎So when I grow up, I'm going to be a warrior.⏎▼⏎But to do that, do I have to go traveling and training, like you?
You beat Fargo?! Wow, that's amazing! Maybe I won't be a warrior after all. Maybe I'll be a Spiritcaller like you!
King Geas of Blanick is a warlike king, and a very dangerous one. Only recently he marched his troops on Grinos, the desert town.⏎▼⏎There's no telling when he might attack Rideen as well.
If King Geas of Blanick should ever get his hands on the Book of Ether... oh, it frightens me just to think of it.⏎▼⏎Whatever would become of us?
The Book of Ether must surely be in King Geas's hands.⏎▼⏎Your father, too, will have gone to Blanick in pursuit of the Book of Ether.
King Geas, and now Fargo... Why must the people of Blanick be so fond of fighting?⏎▼⏎I cannot stop worrying over when the harm will reach our own kingdom.
Our thanks to you for defeating Fargo.⏎▼⏎Still, King Geas weighs on my mind more than ever. What ambition can he be scheming?⏎▼⏎We must put our troops in order without a moment's delay.
You would be the Spirit Mage of the Spirit Sanctum of Melrode, I take it. Her Majesty Queen Diana is expecting you. Please, go right in.
You are the Spirit Mage? I never imagined you would be such a child. ...Ah, forgive me.

We had Fargo shut away in a good, solid cell with lock upon lock on it, I tell you.⏎▼⏎And he still got out. Somebody must've helped him.⏎▼⏎He only broke out the other day. So I figure anyone who's come to town lately is a suspect.⏎▼⏎But Rideen's a big town, with folk coming and going all the time... What a fix.
You beat Fargo -- THE Fargo?! That can't be... A little lad like you beat him?!⏎▼⏎You're one incredible kid. But I suppose that's what a Spiritcaller is, eh? Well, I'll be.

My grandpa was a miner, see, and they say he's the one who dug up the ruins in Veragoon Tunnel.⏎▼⏎But no sooner had the ruins turned up than the monsters started multiplying... and in the end the mine was shut down, so I hear.⏎▼⏎Maybe it's better not to touch old stuff nobody understands, huh?

A beautiful woman in the ruins of the abandoned mine? What would a beauty be doing in a place like that? If I'd known, I'd have gone myself!⏎▼⏎But wait a sec. Maybe that beauty was really a monster, huh?
This is Rideen Castle, where Her Majesty Queen Diana resides: the most beautiful castle in all of Celtland.
Nobody wants 'em anymore, see. So you might as well have some Traveler's Black Wings. Take 'em along.
Already got Traveler's Black Wings, eh? Once you've used 'em up, come back. I'll give you new ones.

These days King Geas has a Spiritcaller serving him who's like some kind of monster. Guilty, or some such.⏎▼⏎They say he turned up from who knows where not long ago... He's the one who ravaged the town like this. Said it was 'magic research'...
With a war about to start, whatever made you come in from outside? Well, rest a while before you go.{F2}

A month ago, a fearsome Spiritcaller and a suspicious woman came to King Geas... That's when it started. That's when King Geas went wrong.⏎▼⏎Nobody can stop him now. With the terrible magic power he's got hold of, King Geas means to burn Celtland to ashes...

Thinking of getting into Blanick Castle? Nobody can get through the main gate anymore. I've heard there's a back way in somewhere...⏎▼⏎But what do you mean to do there? Fight King Geas? Hmph... Don't make me laugh, boy.
No use struggling now. King Geas is gonna burn everything to the ground. You'd best do whatever you like while you still can.
I got hurt, so I don't have to join this war after all... Not that it matters. They'll get us all anyway...
Everyone who defied King Geas was killed. My little brother's dead too... And the ones left are scared to death of him.⏎▼⏎This town's finished. Nobody's getting out of here alive!⏎▼⏎It's all over!
You a Spiritcaller? A bearded Spirit Mage who looked like you went off toward the castle.
Here, lad, have these Smelling Salts. We've no use for 'em anymore, not us. I've a feeling you need 'em more than we do.
Oh, you've already got Smelling Salts. When they're gone, come back. I'll give you as many as you like. And a kid like you shouldn't be in a hurry to die, hear?
King Geas of Blanick burned this town with his terrible power.⏎▼⏎My son got separated from me then, and nobody knows where he went... Where can he be now, I wonder, and what is he doing?

Listen to this! My son, the one I thought was lost, has sent me a letter from Lalapool!⏎▼⏎Thank heavens... I'm so glad I waited for him.⏎▼⏎Oh, that's the Fire Ruby, isn't it? With that, you'll be able to go from the desert through Task Hazard to the town of Haliel.

Ever seen that Guilty fellow? They say he's a Spiritcaller, but that's a lie. Any way you look at it, he's a monster!⏎▼⏎He's the one who hauled off everyone who wouldn't obey King Geas, too. And to keep a fiend like that under him...⏎▼⏎What's come over King Geas? He had ambitions, sure, but he used to be a decent king. Is it all Guilty's doing?

What's to become of this town...? They say it was King Geas who burned Grinos to the ground. There's no knowing when it'll happen here too.⏎▼⏎Do the people of Rideen and Darlam know about any of this, I wonder?⏎▼⏎Are they resting easy, thinking their world is at peace...?
J-Jean-Jacques... ...All this time since I saw you... you've grown... so strong... Ngh...⏎▼⏎...Geas... is trying to... destroy... Celtland... The Book of Ether... is... Nnngh...
Jean-Jacques! Bart went on ahead, further in.⏎▼⏎I came to help him, but he said it was dangerous and told me to wait here.⏎▼⏎If you're going on, I can heal you up here first. What'll it be?{F2}

Fufu... I live here all alone. Hardly anyone ever comes by, you know.⏎▼⏎They say this forest connects, somewhere, with the Blue Cave, the one that leads to a lovely valley.⏎▼⏎But I've heard the way won't open without the spirits' leave.

Fufu, back again? Could it be you're interested in me?⏎▼⏎Oh my, that's the Water Jewel. If you have that, it means the spirits have given you their leave.⏎▼⏎With it, I believe you can pass along the road to Blue Cape too.
What's a little shrimp like you doin' in a place like this? Kids oughta be off to bed, and quick!{F2}

Takes some nerve, boy, climbin' aboard a pirate ship like it's nothin'. Captain's given his say-so, so there's nothin' for it, but normally we'd be tossin' you in the lake.⏎▼⏎Still, if you're a Spiritcaller, maybe you'll be some use sortin' out what's gone wrong with the lake.

Hey, boy. The lake's back to normal. Thanks. You're somethin' else, for a kid.⏎▼⏎Come to think of it, the captain's taken a real shine to that priestess. He's been goin' to see her day after day lately.⏎▼⏎Honestly, a feisty girl like that... what's he see in her? Beats me, it does.

That getup -- you're from the Sanctum, right? You know this rude pirate? He makes me so mad!⏎▼⏎All right, sure, it was my slip-up that the Water Jewel got stolen, but it's the one who stole it who messed up the lake!⏎▼⏎Looks like she ran from the Stone Circle up on the hill down to the bottom of the lake. She looked so full of herself!⏎▼⏎If only I'd been stronger, I could've beaten her... Grr, it's so frustrating!

Breaking that ward and getting the Water Jewel back... you're no ordinary kid, huh?⏎▼⏎I'll leave that Spirit Gem in your keeping. Got it? Don't you dare lose it.⏎▼⏎The priestesses of Lake Lenos have guarded the Spirit Gem for generations, to hand it to a great Spiritcaller. You're such a shrimp, I can't tell if you're great or not.⏎▼⏎But you're strong, I'll give you that. So please, I'm begging you, take this rude pirate with you!

What the--?! What the--?! Where in blazes did you fall from?⏎▼⏎Tryin' to board my ship? You must have a death wish. This here's a pirate ship out of Nord!⏎▼⏎Nothin' but weird goings-on lately. Spiritcallers fallin' outta the sky, strange currents in the lake, the ship sailin' off on its own...⏎▼⏎It's more'n us pirates can stand. Where in the world are we headed now, anyway?⏎▼⏎No use thinkin' about it. Reckon I'll go rest in my cabin.
Hey, an island like this, out in a place like this? Now that's a shocker!⏎▼⏎And the reason the lake's gone haywire was on this here island all along. Well, if that don't beat all.

Heh, so that's the Water Jewel. Bet it'd fetch a fine price. Bein' a pirate, I'd sure like to have it...⏎▼⏎Eh, but this priestess'd chew me out. I'll let it slide.⏎▼⏎Oh yeah, this priestess is a riot to tease. She goes beet red and flies off the handle. Maybe I'll swing by every so often and give her a ribbing.
A customer, after all this time! Haven't had one since I took a bearded Spirit Mage gentleman across, a month back.⏎▼⏎Go on, climb aboard. This boat's bound for Lalapool.
This here's the ferry to Lalapool. Go on, climb aboard.
We're in a fix, friend. The boat's stopped dead.⏎▼⏎A strange current's sprung up on the lake, and I can't steer her where I want.⏎▼⏎No way to get the boat moving like this. What a mess...
Good timing. I was just getting ready to cast off.⏎▼⏎Wind's nice and fair, so we'll be in Rideen in no time. Go on, climb aboard.
This here's the ferry to Darlam. Go on, climb aboard.
Past here, through the cave they call Task Hazard, you'll find the town of Haliel.⏎▼⏎But it's a long, long way to get there, you know. Do rest here before you set off.{F2}

This way leads to Windward Forest, but it's closed right now.⏎▼⏎Somebody smashed the bridge. What a rotten thing to do! That was a fine bridge, and we built it ourselves!⏎▼⏎Come to think of it, they say some shady fellow with power over the wind showed up in the forest. I wonder if he's the one who wrecked the bridge.
Looks like that Spiritcaller in the forest is gone. The wind that stopped is blowing just like before.
Want to go this way, sonny? Sorry, can't be done -- the bridge is broken. Looks like it'll take a while to fix.⏎▼⏎If you want to get to Haliel, the only way is through the Task Hazard cave.
Sonny, I've fixed the bridge! Now you can go through the forest to Haliel as you please.
It has been quite some time since a guest came over on the ferry. Spirit Mage, if you like, please stay here and rest away your weariness.{F2}

So you're Jean-Jacques, are you? Good of you to come. I'm Epona.⏎▼⏎You're carrying the Spirit Gems now. They're things only the true Spiritcaller can use.⏎▼⏎I know the Book of Ether was stolen. A thousand years ago, there was a great war over that book...⏎▼⏎They fought over it without a one of them knowing the truth of the book. No one can handle its power. Summon it, and that's the end -- the world goes racing headlong to ruin.⏎▼⏎That's exactly why it has to be taken back. Use the magic circle in the back room to go to Aqua Island on Lake Lenos.⏎▼⏎The Water Spirit's Gem is there. Go and borrow it from Coron, the priestess who guards it.

Got the Gem, I see. Now mark this. The truth is, the Gems are a double-edged sword. They hold the power of the Book of Ether sealed inside them.⏎▼⏎So handle them badly and you could end up setting that power free. But on the other hand, if you're strong, you can wipe that power out for good.⏎▼⏎Jean-Jacques. Grow strong. From the moment you took up those Gems, the spirits chose you, like it or not.⏎▼⏎I never wanted to make a child like you do such a thing... but the spirits have chosen. That's one thing there's no helping.⏎▼⏎Now, the Stone Circle outside will take you back to Lalapool. Mind how you go. May the spirits be with you always...

I've been waiting for you, Jean-Jacques. This is the world's dark underside, made from the wicked hearts of men. It's the very last place where I can lend you a hand.⏎▼⏎Past here, no one can help you anymore...⏎▼⏎Well, then -- will you rest a bit before you go?{F2}
Jean-Jacques! Jean-Jacques! Tired? Tired! Stay over! Stay over?{F2}

...Someone comes here, after how many hundreds of years... You... you bear the Spirit Gems. Then are you the one I have so long awaited?⏎▼⏎My name is Larva. For bringing about the Day of Calamity, I was cursed, and cannot even die...⏎▼⏎Yes... a thousand years ago...⏎▼⏎Seeking to make the world my own, I used the Book of Ether and called forth a terrible power.⏎▼⏎But it held no power save the power to destroy! A power that envies life, and hates it!⏎▼⏎When Epona, a Spiritcaller who bore the Spirit Gems, chained that power in a prison, I was relieved from the bottom of my heart. For I had come to fear the very power I had summoned...⏎▼⏎You who bear the Gems. You are one charged with a mission... Destroy that power. So long as it exists, I must go on living...
Oh, a traveler, are you?... The road only grows harder from here on, so rest here a while, if you like.{F2}
What did you come to a town like this for? Most everything's burned, but there's still Wonder Remedy left.⏎▼⏎I'll give it to you.
What did you come to a town like this for? Most everything's burned, but there's still Wonder Remedy left.⏎▼⏎But looks like you've already got some.
Oh, what has befallen you? Did you lose your way in the desert?⏎▼⏎You must be weary from your long journey. Rest here, if you wish.{F2}

I couldn't stand the war, so I fled the town of Blanick. But past here, there's nothing but desert.⏎▼⏎They say long, long ago this was all green grassland, and far to the south there was a beautiful kingdom... Can you believe it?
Luckily, this place didn't burn. Because it's an inn, maybe? We've got beds, so go on and rest.{F2}
...You a traveler? If you're bound for Blanick, rest up here first... What'll it be? Staying the night?{F2}

......Bart! Bart!⏎▼⏎Hold on, sir! You're all right now. Come, let's get out of here, quickly. Can you stand?
Bart
Th-that voice... Leon... is it you? ...Jean-Jacques... What of Jean-Jacques... what has...?
Leon

...I don't know. But the evil aura that has shrouded this castle all this time is gone.⏎▼⏎It's most likely thanks to Jean-Jacques.⏎▼⏎Together with the spirits, he has protected Celtland from an evil being. He is the true Spiritcaller, without a doubt!
Bart

Jean-Jacques...! You -- my little Jean-Jacques -- the true Spiritcaller? Who would have thought... I thought you were only a child...⏎▼⏎Stay safe, Jean-Jacques... Spirits, I beg you, protect my son...
Titi
Thank you for all your kindness. I am going home to Grinos now. Please keep well, everyone in Haliel.
Annette
So you're off, are you? I heard Grinos had burned down... And still you'll go back, dear?
Titi

Yes. They say it is safe now. It is my home. Even if my house is gone and the land laid waste, I wish to go back.⏎▼⏎Besides, a house can simply be built again. We all intend to make Grinos as it was. However long it takes, surely...
Annette
Is that so. Well, that's a fine thing, that is. With a heart like that, I'd say the town will be itself again. You do your best, dear.
Titi
Yes.⏎Thank you so very much.⏎▼⏎Zelse... it is sad that he is not here... But I shall do it for him as well... I shall!
Leila

Ah... the hateful will to destroy has vanished... This is your doing, Jean-Jacques, is it not?⏎▼⏎I, Leila, believed in your strength. I sensed your firm will and your gentle heart, and knew that you, surely, would see it through...!⏎▼⏎...And yet I cannot see you... Where are you? Please, oh please, be safe...!⏎▼⏎O spirits, I beseech you, guide the one you have chosen back to us... Carry our prayers to the true Spiritcaller...!
Epona

Mammon is gone... Jean-Jacques. You've done what I never could, haven't you.⏎▼⏎Mammon, whom I could only seal away... Just to keep him held down, I've clung to life for a thousand years...⏎▼⏎Now, at long last, I can sleep. I've nothing left to regret... I'll leave the rest to you.⏎▼⏎It's the young, full of strength, who'll go on to build a new world. There's no need for me to watch over it.⏎▼⏎You'll be all right. Give it your all...! Jean-Jacques...!
